items.name: Adriana M.
items.text: Spotless room, quiet air conditioning and a closed garage for the rental car. Exactly what I needed for a week-long assignment.

items.name: Jean-Baptiste K.
items.text: Warm welcome at reception, and the kitchenette changed everything with the kids. Quiet neighbourhood, we slept really well.

cta.title: Book your room in 30 seconds
cta.subtitle: Message us on WhatsApp, call reception or send an email. We confirm availability and rates quickly.

items.q: How do I book a room?
items.a: Message us on WhatsApp, call reception or send an email. Share your dates and the number of guests: we confirm availability and the rate.
Reception is open every day from 8am to 5pm. A later arrival is possible on request.
Yes. The house has a closed two-space garage inside the property, with a guarded gate.
Every room has a kitchenette, air conditioning, a comfortable bed and a private bathroom with shower and WC. Housekeeping comes three times a week.
They are indicative. The final price and availability are confirmed when you book.
